integrity: The proof replays the source representation theorem with the auxiliary group restricted from the ambient carrier W to the common local outcome range O(w). Uniform range supplies neighborhoods containing any target u, independence supplies nonempty intersections, and the cyclic group on O(w) realizes u exactly. A two-agent single-neighborhood frame gives a matching lower bound because each fixed action has at most as many distinct outcomes as the other agent has actions. The primary full text and the closest 2026 actual-power representation paper were inspected at their representation constructions and scope statements.
scientific_limitations: The result sharpens the deterministic individual-agent representation construction and gives a worst-case optimal multiplicative factor. It does not solve minimum-action realization for arbitrary actual-effectivity frames, proper coalitions, or generalized set-valued outcome games.
title: Sharp local-range compression for actual-effectivity representations
